changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionCatalogItem') BEGIN create table api.ExecutionCatalogItem ( ExecutionId int not null, [Type] char(1) not null,
TypeSourceId nvarchar(500), TypeId int,
-- Assets SourceId nvarchar(500) sparse, Id bigint, Uid uniqueidentifier,
-- Relations SubjectSourceId nvarchar(500) sparse, SubjectId bigint sparse, ObjectSourceId nvarchar(500) sparse, ObjectId bigint sparse,
[Action] char(1), [Success] bit, [Message] nvarchar(500) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'cix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem') BEGIN create clustered index cix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId desc, [Type] asc) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_TypeSourceId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_TypeSourceId on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, TypeSourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Id_Success') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Id_Success on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId, [Type], Id, Success) include (TypeId, SourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SourceId_Id_Success') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SourceId_Id_Success on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId, [Type], [SourceId], Id, Success) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_TypeId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_TypeId on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, TypeId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SourceId') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SourceId on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, SourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SubjectSourceId_ObjectSourceId_Success') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_SubjectSourceId_ObjectSourceId_Success on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId, [Type], Success, SubjectSourceId, ObjectSourceId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Id') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Id on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId asc, [Type] asc, Id) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Execution') BEGIN create index ix_ApiExecutionCatalogItem_Execution on api.ExecutionCatalogItem (ExecutionId) END
